# One case per line: name|directory|arguments of the verify command.
# The directory is relative to the fixture repository that verify_test.go
# builds; "outside" names a directory outside any Git repository. Arguments
# split on spaces. Each case has a <name>.golden: the exit code and stdout of
# `putnami tree verify <arguments>` in that directory.
no-mode|.|
unknown-argument|.|bogus
two-modes|.|--snapshot --ref app.txt
report-without-gate|.|--snapshot --report .context/report.json
gate-without-report|.|--gate .context/session.json
missing-value|.|--ref
flag-as-value|.|--ref --snapshot
outside-git|outside|--ref app.txt
ref|.|--ref app.txt
ref-from-subdirectory|src|--ref app.txt
ref-missing|.|--ref absent.txt
ref-directory|.|--ref src
snapshot|.|--snapshot --base main~1
snapshot-default-base|.|--snapshot
snapshot-unknown-base|.|--snapshot --base nosuch
record|.|--record .context/dossier.json
record-with-workflow|.|--record .context/dossier-workflow.json
record-base|.|--record .context/dossier.json --base main~1
record-other-base|.|--record .context/dossier.json --base main
record-stale|.|--record .context/dossier-stale.json
record-missing|.|--record .context/absent.json
workflow|.|--workflow .context/workflow.json
workflow-restored|.|--workflow .context/workflow-restored.json
workflow-missing|.|--workflow .context/absent.json
gate|.|--gate .context/session.json --report .context/report.json --base main~1
gate-default-base|.|--gate .context/session.json --report .context/report.json
gate-narrower|.|--gate .context/session-narrow.json --report .context/report.json --base main~1
